text: The purpose of this letter is to make changes to the Centre 55 Board of Management. The Board confirmed two new appointments at their June 10th Annual General Meeting. The Board confirms that these nominees are qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, the following nominees to the Community Centre 55 Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term expiring on June 30, 2029 and until successors are appointed: - Natalie Johnson - Pauline Gran
